open_points.subject: Connect an object to its folders
open_points.text: a photo folder linked outside the root is refused when it is used
open_points.question: Which product action refuses a photo subfolder that is written inside the root but resolves through a link outside it: the connection write, or the later action that reads the folder?
options: The connection write refuses it and no confirmed ObjectConnection is created or updated.
The connection write accepts and confirms it; See what can be delivered or Place chosen photos refuses it when reading the folder.
Both the connection write and every later read validate and may refuse it.
open_points.default_guess: Accept it at connection time and refuse it when a delivery action reads it, because the passage says "when it is used".

witness.initial: No connection exists; photo_subfolder is lexically inside root but is a link to a directory outside root.
events: The owner confirms the object and written folder paths.
The agent performs Connect an object to its folders.
The deliverer later reads the photo folder.
outcomes: The connect action is refused, so no confirmed connection exists.
A confirmed connection is written; only the later delivery read is refused.
witness.observer: The owner through the agent, and the calling delivery flow

open_points.subject: ObjectConnection assignment confirmation
open_points.text:
`assignment_confirmed` records that the owner confirmed
these exact folders for this object. Both subfolders are written as paths inside the root.
open_points.question: Does the owner's confirmation attach only to the stored path values, or also to the filesystem directories to which those paths and links resolve?
options: Confirmation attaches to the stored root and subfolder path values; retargeting a link does not clear it, though use may be refused.
Confirmation attaches to the resolved directories; changing a link target invalidates or clears confirmation even though no stored field changed.
Confirmation attaches to both, with a separate rule defining when resolved-target changes are detected.
open_points.default_guess: Treat confirmation as attaching to the stored path values and leave it set when a link target changes, because the stated lifecycle clears it only when the root or a subfolder value changes.

witness.initial: A confirmed ObjectConnection has a photo_subfolder path resolving inside root.
events: A filesystem actor retargets a link in that path to a directory outside root without changing the ObjectConnection fields.
The deliverer reads the connection and attempts to use the folder.
outcomes: The record remains confirmed, but folder use is refused.
The confirmation is no longer valid or is cleared, and delivery stops as an unconfirmed connection.
witness.observer: The agent inspecting the record and the delivery caller

open_points.subject: Connect an object to its folders
open_points.text: a connection whose subfolder is written to leave its root is refused
open_points.question: When an attempted connection write is refused for a subfolder written outside the root, what happens to an existing ObjectConnection and its confirmation?
options: The write is atomic and changes nothing; an existing confirmed connection remains confirmed and unchanged.
The invalid paths are not stored, but the existing connection's confirmation is cleared as a safety effect.
The attempted values are stored in an unconfirmed connection.
open_points.default_guess: Make the refusal atomic and leave any existing connection unchanged.

witness.initial: A project has an existing confirmed ObjectConnection with valid subfolder paths.
events: The owner proposes a new subfolder written to leave the root.
The agent attempts to write the changed connection.
outcomes: The attempt is refused and the old confirmed connection remains unchanged.
The attempt is refused but the connection becomes unconfirmed or stores the attempted path.
witness.observer: The owner through the agent and subsequent delivery actions

open_points.subject: ObjectConnection invoice_subfolder
open_points.text: Both subfolders are written as paths inside the root.
open_points.question: Must invoice_subfolder, like photo_subfolder, also resolve inside the root when it is used, or is only its written path required to be inside the root?
options: Both photo_subfolder and invoice_subfolder must remain inside the root after links are resolved.
Only photo_subfolder has a resolved-location constraint; invoice_subfolder needs only a written path inside the root.
Resolved-location behavior for invoice_subfolder is intentionally unrestricted.
open_points.default_guess: Apply the resolved-location constraint to both subfolders, while validating it when each folder is used.

witness.initial: A confirmed connection has invoice_subfolder written inside root but linked to a directory outside root.
events: The owner confirms the written paths.
A later invoice consumer reads invoice_subfolder.
outcomes: The invoice folder is refused because its resolved location is outside root.
The invoice folder is accepted because the text states the link check only for the photo folder.
witness.observer: The later invoice consumer and the owner
